profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | AI Agents in Production (Claude, MCP) | Founding-Team Experience
profile.summary:
I'm a self-taught software engineer with 30 years of experience building full-stack systems from the ground up — and a consistent pattern of showing up early at companies that were still figuring out what they were building.
I was part of the founding engineering team at Adaption Technologies, an early employee at startup Splitrock Services, and have spent the last year serving as the sole engineer at two organizations simultaneously — including shipping a production AI voice ordering system built on Flask, Twilio, and Claude API with custom MCP servers. Before that, 16 years at Cisco Systems (through the BroadSoft and Adaption acquisitions) owning FedRAMP-compliant cloud PBX infrastructure, deployment automation, and security operations at enterprise scale.
My work sits at the intersection of backend engineering, workflow automation, and AI integration. I build things that reduce manual effort, surface insights for decision-makers, and hold up in production. At WhiteWater Express Carwash I architected a greenfield PHP/MySQL platform serving 150+ locations, engineered HR and payroll workflow state machines that cut manual processing by 70%, and built data pipelines integrating a half-dozen operational systems. At Speedwash, I own the full stack — from server infrastructure through reporting suite — solo.
I'm a builder by nature, not just by profession. That same instinct to figure out how things work and make them better shows up in everything I do.
Currently open to founding-engineer and senior engineering roles where AI integration, workflow automation, and full production ownership are at the center of the work.
Specialties: PHP · Python · JavaScript · MySQL · PostgreSQL · Flask · React · LLM Integration · MCP (Model Context Protocol) · AI Agent Architecture · DevOps · FedRamp/Regulated Systems · API Design · Workflow Automation · Data Pipelines · GCP · AWS

projects.title: Freebie List — Automated Content Pipeline
projects.description:
Built an automated newsletter pipeline that searches the web weekly for legitimate free offers — games, software,
  sweepstakes, mail-in samples — and compiles them into a curated, styled email digest, with a scam/red-flag filter and
  self-improving source discovery.

  - Designed a search-first architecture over a fixed scrape list: a self-updating "hints" system tracks which sources have
  historically paid off (with automatic 90-day staleness pruning), while every run still does a fresh general web search — so
  the pipeline discovers new sources organically instead of calcifying around a hardcoded list.
  - Built a content pipeline in Node.js: structured extraction, deduplication against a rolling history of previously-seen
  items, and a rule-based red-flag filter that rejects "free" offers requiring upfront payment or personal info.
  - Engineered a rich HTML email renderer (not a markdown converter) with category banners, platform-specific color coding, and
  featured/recommended item treatments for a polished, branded reader experience.
  - Covered the pipeline with a full unit test suite (dedup, filtering, formatting, hint-tracking) and validated it against two
  live end-to-end runs before considering it review-ready.
  - Roadmap: subscriber management and Stripe billing ($1/mo or $10/yr tier) as a follow-on phase once the content pipeline is
  proven.

projects.title: AI Voice Ordering Agent
projects.description:
Production voice AI that takes phone orders end-to-end — inbound call handling, natural-language order processing, and multi-turn dialogue — built on Flask, Twilio, and the Claude API.

Designed and built custom MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers from scratch (no frameworks) for agent tool integration and extensibility. Architecture generalizes beyond restaurants to any phone-based intake workflow. Demonstrates a viable alternative to traditional phone ordering with lower staffing costs and higher order accuracy.
